name: safetoship
description: Create deterministic launch evidence for AI-built apps and pair it with deep security reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Create a deterministic pre-launch evidence packet.
interface.longDescription: SafeToShip helps Codex audit an AI-built app, record coverage and deltas, repair high-confidence launch blockers, and combine that evidence with an available deep security review before the human decides to deploy.
defaultPrompt: Audit this app with SafeToShip before I launch it.
Use SafeToShip to harden this project and show what still needs review.
Run a full launch review and keep SafeToShip and Codex Security evidence separate.
